ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the distal segments of both lobes. These regions are populated by discrete, low-intensity circular spots and linear streaks. The proximal central region near the median notch is comprised of a solid, low-intensity black mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; estimated pixel angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude irregular serrations characterized by jagged peaks and valleys along the entire continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the superior margin of both lobes, transitioning from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, low-intensity pixel clusters (scars) distributed across the white distal regions. Distinct, high-intensity, textured 3D clusters (barnacles) are located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous parallel and unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the white pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization on the distal tips; extensive healed rake marks and circular scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique visual texture provided by the heavy barnacle encrustation on the outermost points of the fluke contour.
